## Skilled Sniper (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
Half-elf rogue 3  
CN Medium humanoid (elf, human)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +11  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+3 armor, +3 Dex)  
**hp** 23 (3d8+6)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +6, **Will** +1; +2 vs. enchantments  
**Defensive Abilities** evasion, trap sense +1; **Immune** sleep  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** rapier +4 (1d6+1/18–20)  
**Ranged** mwk rifle +6 (1d10/×4)  
**Special Attacks** sneak attack +2d6  


**Tactics**


**Before Combat** The marksman picks a perch that’s hard to reach and waits for targets to come into range.  

**During Combat** The marksman uses his rifle as long as possible but reverts to rapier if forced.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 12, **Dex** 17, **Con** 14, **Int** 13, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 16  
**Feats** [Point-Blank Shot](../../rules/feats/point-blank-shot.md), Skill Focus (Perception), [Weapon Focus (rapier)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Point-Blank Shot and Precise Shot are one feat, Point-Blank Shot; in their place: Weapon Focus (rapier).*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +9, Climb +7, Disguise +5, Escape Artist +9, Perception +11, Perform (wind) +5, Ride +6, Stealth +9, Survival +3, Swim +7  
**Languages** Common, Dwarven, Elven  
**SQ** elf blood, rogue talents (surprise attack), trapfinding +1  
**Combat Gear** oil of magic weapon (2), potion of cure light wounds, potion of invisibility; **Other Gear** masterwork omniweave armor, masterwork rifle with 20 metal cartridges, rapier, 73 gp
